The Removable option has a soft checkered sheet background and is easy to reposition while you arrange your layout. It’s a handy choice for planners, journals, study notes, and seasonal notebook pages when you want more flexibility. The Transparent option has clear areas around each design, so the sticker illustrations can sit neatly over colored paper, covers, labels, and other stationery without adding a large visible sheet background.
Use these school stickers to mark study plans, decorate reading logs, add personality to letters, or build a fun journal spread. The mix of larger cat and classroom scenes with smaller stationery icons gives you plenty of ways to balance a page. The printed designs have colorful details and clean outlines that stand out clearly. Choose Removable or Transparent to match your decorating style, then check out the photos to learn more!
